rv.q: A lavish cartoon, but a cartoon nonetheless, that now seems musically undernourished, only fitfully entertaining and, most damaging of all, emotionally barren.
This is an excellent production, with every cast member contributing to the overall enjoyment.
Egan's oddly spirited Belle 25 years later is still perfection, as she portrays the self-educated provincial girl who understands what it means to be different.
